scope: Read-only persisted-geometry precheck (page_size 4096, auto_vacuum 0, page_count <= existing cap) before the writable open of existing owner and protected-root SQLite files. Corrects the r1 defect in which a writable refusal checkpointed and deleted a retained WAL. Established only for the tested fixture: a file with 8192-byte pages and a retained WAL with -shm, left by a fresh process that exited without Close. Refused geometry leaves the main database and WAL byte-identical for the owner and for the protected root. Not established: WAL-needs-recovery states, non-geometry refusals, power-loss or EIO behavior, dedicated filesystem or quota, or any D14/G1 qualification. Green tests verify code, not evidence of the claim.

design.precheck: openSettledOwnerDatabase (existing read-only helper, unchanged) reads page_size, auto_vacuum and page_count before openOwnerDatabase in openExistingSQLiteOwnerWithCeiling and in OpenExistingProtectedRoot (after the root lock). A mismatch returns ErrOwnerStore with the existing messages.
design.unreadable_geometry: A read error does not refuse. The writable open runs unchanged and still verifies geometry and the ceiling. A read-only connection may be unable to run WAL recovery, so refusing on a read error could block recovery.
design.unchanged: writable DSN ceiling and read-back, LoadSettledCheckpoint seam, typed ErrOwnerStore, locks, deadlines and fences. No VACUUM, migration, or cap change.

limitations: Non-geometry refusals (VerifyStore, verifyNamespace, ceiling read-back) still run after the writable open and may checkpoint a retained WAL. No byte-identity claim is made for them.
Unreadable geometry (for example, a WAL that needs recovery) falls through to the unchanged writable open. An incompatible file in that state can still be changed by its refusal. Not tested.
Tested shape: one retained WAL (64 rows, 8192-byte pages) with -shm present. Missing or invalid -shm, OS crash, and concurrent processes are not tested.
Each existing owner or root open adds one read-only connection under openSettledOwnerDatabase's 10 s ping bound. Latency is not measured.
Single engine and platform: modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.1 (SQLite 3.53.4) on Linux under WSL2.
